# Chapter 3: The Education

Michigan State University was not a destination so much as a trajectory.

Bob had applied because it was the thing you did after high school if you were good at math and science and not yet sure what you wanted to be. The campus, sprawled across the eastern edge of Lansing, was larger than anything Bob had encountered—a town within a town, ten thousand students moving between brick buildings that were supposed to look old but were mostly just red brick.
